features.title: Verifiable data
features.desc: Ranges, accuracy classes, nameplate markings and visible construction are reported as observed; unconfirmed values are not generalized across models.

features.title: Materials and connections

features.title: Installation and maintenance
features.desc: Account for orientation, vibration, pressure pulsation and service clearance during selection; add damping, isolation or protection where required.

about.title: About Jingfeng Instruments
about.subtitle: Over 20 years in instrument cabling — an integrated group spanning R&D, manufacturing and trade.
about.story: Jingfeng Group Co., Ltd., founded in November 2005 with a registered capital of RMB 380.88 million, is a group enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing and trade. Its subsidiaries cover instruments, electrical equipment and polymer materials, with products ranging from wire and cable to complete systems, cable trays, pipe fittings, valves and switchgear. A national "Little Giant", High-Tech Enterprise and Green Factory, the group holds 160+ patents, exports worldwide, and maintains long-term partnerships with State Grid, CNNC and Sinopec.
about.mission: To be the premium service provider of intelligent power transmission system solutions — striving for excellence in every crystal and every peak. With the vision of "Building a century-lasting Jingfeng, striving to be the industry benchmark", we uphold the core values of "Integrity, Service, Win-Win", create value for customers, power the industrial pulse, guard accurate measurement, and become your expert in cable, instrument and electrical solutions.
about.orgIntro: The group follows 6S standardized management with a clear, efficient structure covering production, sales, technology, quality inspection, equipment, finance, procurement and the group general office.
